Mia (FinOps): Heads up — found ~120 invoices in last night's close with missing proration/usage lines. Looks like Stripe webhooks were delayed/replayed and our ingestion applied invoice.create without the separate usage lines. Filing here so we can coordinate cleanup.

Raj (Payments Eng): Ugh — do you have example customer IDs or invoice IDs we can grep for? Any pattern by region or plan?

Mia (FinOps): Example invoice ids: inv_01Gk3A8X, inv_01Gk4B7Y. Customers cus_J8k3... and cus_L0m9... Mostly NA accounts, time around 2026-03-22 05:00-05:30 UTC. Quick log excerpt:
```
2026-03-22T05:10:12Z INFO webhook-ingest worker-3 received evt: evt_1 (invoice.created) id=inv_01Gk3A8X order_seq=482
2026-03-22T05:10:28Z INFO webhook-ingest worker-1 received evt: evt_2 (invoice.finalized) id=inv_01Gk3A8X order_seq=485
2026-03-22T05:10:29Z ERROR invoice-processor apply-lines failed: missing usages for invoice inv_01Gk3A8X
```
Notable: seq gap 482 -> 485 and the finalization arrived before usage lines applied.

integrations-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: stripe-webhooks queue retry_count>5 at 2026-03-22T05:11:00Z. Detected sequence gap: last_seq=482, seen_seq=485. Added to DLQ: 3 events. Ticket INC-2026-3387 created.

Elena (Billing Ops): Please DO NOT manually issue credits for these customers yet — we risk double-applies when we replay. I'll pause the nightly NetSuite push for the 05:00 window.

Sam (FinOps): Ran a quick query to surface scope:
```sql
SELECT i.id, i.customer_id, i.created_at, i.lines_count, u.count AS usage_events
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) as count FROM usage_events WHERE created_at between '2026-03-22T05:00:00Z' and '2026-03-22T05:30:00Z' GROUP BY invoice_id) u ON u.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.created_at between '2026-03-22T05:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T05:30:00Z' AND i.lines_count < COALESCE(u.count,0);
```
Found 118 invoices matching. Exporting IDs to GDrive: gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-03-22-missing-lines.csv

Raj (Payments Eng): Root cause theory: when the webhook consumer scaled/restarted we lost ordering guarantees because we currently only rely on arrival time, not stripe-provided ordering headers. We'll patch ingestion to buffer/order by stripe_event.created + our stripe_sequence header and dedupe by event.id before applying financial changes. I'll open a PR now (payments/webhooks#452). ETA for deploy: ~4 hours if tests pass.

Mia (FinOps): Good. For remediation: Elena — keep NetSuite push paused for that window. Sam — can you prepare an idempotent backfill that replays DLQ but does a checksum compare before applying lines? We should also run a dry-run first.

Elena (Billing Ops): Will hold manual adjustments and NetSuite push for 05:00-05:30 UTC customers. Also I'll run the draft-invoice validation to catch invoices with inconsistent line counts.

Raj (Payments Eng): Replay command (dry-run first):
```bash
kubectl exec -it deployment/stripe-webhooks -c worker -- ./bin/replay_dlq --since 2026-03-22T05:00:00Z --to 2026-03-22T05:30:00Z --dry-run --dedupe-by-event-id
```
After dry-run we'll run without --dry-run. Replay tool now supports a --checksum-compare flag to avoid applying if checksum matches current invoice.

Sam (FinOps): I'll run dry-run at 12:30 PST and post results. Also proposing adding metrics/alerts: `webhook.sequence_gap`, `webhook.replay_dedupe_rate`, and a dashboard for "invoices with missing usage lines".

Mia (FinOps): :thumbsup: Please coordinate on the ticket and add the incident summary to the finance channel and next retro. Who's owning the postmortem?

Raj (Payments Eng): I'll own the postmortem writeup. Initial action items: (1) deploy ordering/dedupe patch, (2) run DLQ dry-run and reconcile, (3) hold NetSuite push for the window, (4) add metrics + alert.

integrations-bot: Incident INC-2026-3387 updated: status=investigating, assignee=Raj (Payments Eng), severity=medium.

Elena (Billing Ops): I'll coordinate with CS for any impacted customers that ping us. I'll also mark the export csv as the single source for manual review.

Mia (FinOps): Thanks all — keep updates here. Once replay dry-run is green we'll schedule the cleanup and re-enable NetSuite push for the window.
